description: TensorE controls: tiled pipeline (128x128/128x512 geometry) plus shape-offset small single tiles. Calibration is dtype-keyed startup+throughput only; the small-tile grid (m=64,k=64,n={96,192,320,448}) is disjoint from the tiled-attention holdout (m=128,k=128,n={64,128,256,512}). Each shape is compiled three times and consumers take the median: compilation is bimodal, with ~13-21% of compilations of a TensorE control landing in a ~3-4x slower allocation for an identical instruction stream.
